name: Tharil'zun's Head
summary: Tharil'zun's Head reaches Lakeshire as proof that the commander terrorizing the Redridge approaches is dead. He led the Blackrock Outrunners occupying Stonewatch.

sections.title: Trophy of Stonewatch
sections.body: Blackrock orcs at Stonewatch Keep have pressed Lakeshire hard, raiding farms and ambushing travelers on the roads. Tharil'zun directed the Blackrock Outrunners at the head of these attacks. Lakeshire's garrison cannot risk acting on rumors or partial victories, so Marshal Marris demands proof that Tharil'zun is dead. His severed head shows that the Outrunners' coordinated ambushes from the keep have suffered a major blow.

faq.answer: Tharil'zun was a crafty, vicious Blackrock orc commander at Stonewatch Keep. He led the Blackrock Outrunners, who ran relentless ambushes with the Renegades between Lakeshire and the keep.

faq.q: Why does Marshal Marris want his head?
faq.answer: Stormwind withholds major military aid from Redridge, leaving Marshal Marris and the Lakeshire guard to rely on mercenaries to pick off key threats. Marris requires absolute proof of Tharil'zun's death to know the Outrunners' leadership is truly shattered.
Tharil'zun holds Stonewatch Keep in Redridge Mountains' eastern hills, surrounded by Blackrock orcs and gnolls.

faq.q: Does taking Tharil'zun's head end the Blackrock threat?
faq.answer: No. Tharil'zun's death disrupts the Outrunners' ambushes, but the Blackrock clan keeps a massive entrenched force in Stonewatch Keep and across the Redridge Mountains.

angles.text: Each Blackrock chieftain slain eases the pressure on Lakeshire, a beleaguered town fighting for survival without official reinforcements from Stormwind.
